dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Sharp, continuous geometric narrowing from the mid-body toward the posterior peduncle, ending in a pointed distal tip.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Predominantly smooth lateral margins; a slight concave indentation is visible on the lower-left lateral margin at the transition to the peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light grey to off-white; characterized by high-intensity specular reflectance on the right dorsal side and a deep shadow gradient on the left dorsal side.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-density, diffuse grey clusters are visible around the anterior blowhole region and along the mid-to-lower lateral flanks.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient between the primary light-toned dorsal canvas and the darker mottled regions.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced, dark circular blowhole aperture clearly visible on the anterior dorsal midline.
